## What changes for the user or contributor?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when one exists.

## How was this verified?

List the relevant checks and their results. For code changes, run `python scripts/check.py`. For interface changes, include browser checks and screenshots where useful. For advisor changes, state whether a live model was exercised and which model and skill were used.

## Review notes

Mention any saved-data or API changes, new dependencies, remaining limitations, or follow-up work. Keep shared examples fictional and redact private information.

- [ ] I reviewed the contribution guide and kept this PR focused.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks and described their results or why they could not run.
- [ ] I updated documentation when commands or behavior changed.
- [ ] I preserved protected usage and evidence labels where this change affects them.
